claim: Every import() in the appStore object literal runs as soon as the module is evaluated, so all 28 app packages still load eagerly at startup; the PR adds async plumbing at every call site without making anything lazy.

Changing the reschedule callbacks to forEach(async ...) means a throwing getCalendar (e.g. the CalDAV/Apple constructor failing to decrypt the credential) becomes an unhandled promise rejection instead of a synchronous error; the surrounding try/catch in vital/wipemycalother reschedule no longer catches it.
